context.body: The Spirit in the Gospels · Mark 1:21–29
context.label: The Spirit in the Gospels

observations.body: Mark 1:21–29 identifies a qualified or nonhuman spirit within a scene where it is locally described; the wording centers on “Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit.”
observations.label: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit

payload.posture: Read Mark 1:21–29 as evidence about the Spirit, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states mark 1:21–29 identifies a qualified or nonhuman spirit within a scene where it is locally described; the wording centers on “Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
